title: Genetics Laboratory Note: Processing Stage of a Genetic Specimen at Cancellation
content:
How far a Laboratory Test Orders specimen of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class has gone through processing when the accession is cancelled sets a multiplier on the fee basis of the genetic cancellation handling fee.

- **Consent hold.** When the accession is on *testing hold* with the hold reason *informed consent missing*, no DNA extraction has been performed, and the fee basis is multiplied by **0.6**.
- **Just received.** When the accession is *accessioned* and its specimen has been in house fewer than **2** calendar days since its received date, the fee basis is multiplied by **0.25**.
- **Any other stage.** Any other genetic accession keeps the fee basis unmultiplied.

| Status | Hold reason or days in house | Multiplier on the fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| Testing hold | Informed consent missing | 0.6 |
| Testing hold | Any other hold reason (for example prior authorization pending) | unmultiplied |
| Accessioned | 0 or 1 calendar day since the received date | 0.25 |
| Accessioned | 2 calendar days or more since the received date | unmultiplied |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** A specimen received on 10 June is in house 1 calendar day on 11 June, so the multiplier is 0.25. On 12 June it has been in house 2 calendar days, so the fee basis is unmultiplied.
